fixHints.region: Align this region with the design: layout, spacing, type scale, color or assets.
fixHints.color: Use the design/spec token color instead of the current value.
fixHints.length: Fix the size or spacing; check box model and global scaling.
fixHints.keyword: Fix the layout/display keyword; check overrides and component defaults.
fixHints.shadow: Fix shadow parameters (blur, offset, color, spread).
fixHints.font: Fix the font stack order and ensure the preferred font is loaded.
fixHints.number: Fix the numeric property (weight, opacity, z-index, ...).
fixHints.overflow: Remove horizontal overflow: narrow fixed widths, add min-width: 0 or a wrapping strategy.
fixHints.alt: Add meaningful alt text for the image (alt="" for decorative ones).
fixHints.focus: Add a visible focus style (:focus-visible outline or shadow).
fixHints.empty: Give the empty state an explanation and an action entry point.
fixHints.hardcoded: Move inline hard-coded colors into design tokens.
